# Death Saving Throw

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Damage and Healing](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#DeathSavingThrow)*

A player character must make a Death Saving Throw (also called a Death Save) if they start their turn with 0 [Hit Points](../Stats/Hit-Points.md). *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[Damage and Healing](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#DeathSavingThrows)").
